summary: Both design units are implementable and their contracts (errors, boundaries, postconditions) are precise. Unit tests TEST-001..012 have concrete expected values and cover normal, abnormal and boundary cases; integration tests TEST-013/014 exercise IF-001 with the real provider; system tests TEST-015..018 cover every acceptance criterion. Only minor remarks.

checklist.note: DESIGN-001/002 signatures, formula (subtotal*10//100) and output format are unambiguous.
Errors and boundaries listed; ASM-003 fixes text format.
Boundaries 49999/50000/50009, qty 0, price -1, price 0, empty list, order of lines, ValueError passthrough all have exact expected results. TEST-013 arithmetic verified (50010 -> 5001 -> 45009).
TEST-013 (normal) and TEST-014 (error) use default pricer, so real price_order runs.

checklist.item: System specs cover every acceptance criterion
checklist.note: AC-001-1..AC-004-2 are all referenced by TEST-015..018.

checklist.item: Nothing designed that no requirement asks for

findings.description: TEST-012 must import pricing.price_order to compare the default, which slightly conflicts with the REQ-005 wish for receipt unit tests to run without the pricing module; acceptable since receipt itself imports it for the default.
Boundary qty=1 with negative qty (e.g. -1) and unit_price boundary 0 vs -1 only partly covered; qty < 0 is not tested separately from qty 0.
